about_the_game:
This is an early access demo for Yurei Hunt, featuring full gameplay functionality but currently limited to one map—the full game will include more locations to explore.

If you encounter any issues or have thoughts and suggestions, we’d love to hear from you! Use the "Report a Bug" button in the game menu to share feedback or join the discussion on our Discord server.

Thank you for playing, and good luck surviving the hunt!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 8th Gen intel core i5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 11th Gen intel core i5
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3050
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
